versions.changelog:
- Introduces the Self-Improvement skill for logging learnings, errors, and feature requests to structured markdown files for continuous agent improvement.
- Ensures automatic initialization of the `.learnings/` directory and log files if missing, with safeguards to avoid overwriting existing data.
- Outlines clear logging actions for various events (e.g., command failures, user corrections, knowledge gaps, feature requests).
- Documents guidelines for safely logging information, strictly avoiding secrets and sensitive data unless explicitly requested.
- Provides tailored setup instructions and integration guidance for OpenClaw and other agent platforms, including advice on promoting important learnings to broader project memory files.
- Defines standardized log entry formats for learnings and errors, facilitating later review and automated processing.
